channel.title: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

item.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
item.description: For release at 2:00 p.m. EDT. The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent.

item.title: Federal Reserve issues implementation note
item.description: The Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System voted unanimously to raise the interest rate paid on reserve balances.

item.title: Speech by Chair Powell on the economic outlook
item.description: Chair Jerome H. Powell delivered remarks on the economic outlook at the Economic Club.
